title: Iron's spellbooks kilt fix
description: Fixes the textures of weapons in Iron's spellbooks mod when using Kilt 1.20.1
body:
fixes the textures from iron's spellbooks 1.20.1 when using Kilt to play it on fabric
specifically fixes the weapons only, the spellbooks have unique textures but those textures are still pretty bugged.
spellbooks will be properly fixed later
